Thanks Alicia — looping in Grace (Customer Success) and Neha (Security/Compliance) so we can coordinate.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can remove a single conversation from telemetry/indexes in most cases. There are two separate operations: (1) remove references from audit/telemetry indexes and (2) delete stored payloads if data residency and retention rules permit. Both are treated as an atomic support action when requested together but require authorization.

Action items I propose:
1) Marigold Legal to reply to this thread with a short authorization email (name, title, request id).
2) Provide the thread identifier exactly as in your audit_snippet (we'll cross-check).
3) Confirm whether Marigold needs a redacted audit proof only or full deletion from object storage as well.

Grace / Neha — can you confirm our internal checklist and an ETA? My expectation is a 72-hour window for the telemetry/index update and up to 7 days if we need object-level removal and cross-region data residency checks. If Legal requires notarized evidence or extra attestations, that will extend the timeline.

Markus
Head of Sales Operations

Hi Alicia — thanks for the details and the attachments. Summary of our plan and what we need from Marigold Legal: 

Plan:
- Step A (Telemetry/index update): Remove the conversation pointers from our indexing layer and any reporting feeds. This will stop the thread from appearing in activity dashboards and telemetry exports. ETA: 48–72 hours after authorization.
- Step B (Optional storage deletion): If you request, we'll remove stored payloads and attachments from object storage replicas that fall under Redwood-managed retention. This requires cross-checks for residency constraints. ETA: up to 7 business days; we'll provide a manifest of deleted objects.

What we need from Legal:
1) An explicit authorization email that includes: "Marigold Health authorizes Redwood Inference to remove conversation RQ-LODESTAR-477 from telemetry indexes and/or delete stored payloads as indicated." Include signer's full name, title, and date.
2) If deletion is requested, indicate whether Marigold requires deletion records sealed with an attestation or whether a signed audit manifest is sufficient.

Attachments and evidence we'll provide once complete:
- Post-action audit manifest (CSV) listing removed index keys and timestamps.
- A signed confirmation PDF from Redwood (signed by Security lead) with the action timestamp.

Note on billing/metrics: Removing a thread from telemetry does not retroactively credit past billing. Index deletion only affects reporting and future exports. If this is a contractual billing dispute, please flag so we can route to Finance.

I'll open an internal runbook task and assign to our Ops team once we receive Legal's authorization.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success — Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
